nodes.label: Source of Truth Order
nodes.rationale: Task instructions override checkpoint, memori, and code history so active decisions win without rereading old chat history

nodes.label: Verification Budget Smallest Sufficient Check
nodes.rationale: Run only the cheapest relevant checks per change type to avoid slow full rebuilds

nodes.label: Deploy and Scope Guard
nodes.rationale: Finished passing work goes straight to github main Pages; single-feature tasks must not touch other maps or rebuild unrelated assets

nodes.label: Arena and Gameplay Gotchas
nodes.rationale: Keep forts, paths, and colliders walkable and fair so decor never blocks gameplay

nodes.label: Match Event Toast Notification System
nodes.rationale: Small top-center toasts with repo icons and team colors give instant match feedback without covering arena or controls; readability and tidy queue beat aggressive display

nodes.label: Notification Priority Queue
nodes.rationale: Max two visible toasts with round-win overriding normal tags so busy moments stay legible

nodes.label: Minta Rescue Request
nodes.rationale: Give prisoners one meaningful low-cost action with cooldown so prison moments stay interactive without changing tag or rescue balance

nodes.label: Round Stats and Match Leaderboard Panel
nodes.rationale: Quick auto recap between rounds plus manual final panel shows TAG RESCUE PRISON contributions while keeping game flow fast

nodes.label: Local Character Preview Studio
nodes.rationale: Loopback-only local panel keeps preview editing off Pages and off the network so uploads never leak through hosting
